warm_cache.policy: Preserve the original cache alias and every entry before native retry. No driver cache deletion, pruning or replacement. Native tests retain their existing bounded tier policy and may update cache entries normally.

original_owner_warm_cache.policy: Preserve the original cache alias and every entry before native retry. No driver cache deletion, pruning or replacement. Native tests retain their existing bounded tier policy and may update cache entries normally.

cache_key_contract.policy: Opt-in handoff only after closed owner's final content manifest matches every entry, no live owner exists, and the original continuation lock is held. Program cache keys include source fingerprint and loaded ELF; native stencils include native dependency fingerprint plus Wasmtime key; modules use Wasm bytes and Wasmtime identity. Keep old after manifest immutable. No cache copying, deleting or manufactured verdict reuse.
